description: Supplemental denominations (start years) beyond groups_catalog.json — merged by match_denominations_to_councils.py. Not full lineage nodes; used for ±50y council pairing and AI contrast expansion.

denominations.name: Scottish Covenanters
denominations.summary: National Covenant / rejection of episcopacy and royal liturgical impositions in Scotland.

denominations.name: Particular Baptists
denominations.summary: Calvinistic Baptists; believers’ baptism and Reformed soteriology against infant baptism and Catholic sacramental order.

denominations.name: General Baptists
denominations.summary: Arminian Baptists; believers’ baptism against infant baptism and Catholic sacramental order.

denominations.name: United Society of Believers (Shakers)
denominations.summary: Celibate communal restorationism; reject historic sacramental and hierarchical Catholic order.

denominations.name: General Church of the New Jerusalem
denominations.summary: Swedenborgian New Church body; rejects Nicene-Catholic dogma as received in favor of Swedenborg’s revelations.

denominations.name: Evangelical Lutheran Church in America
denominations.summary: Mainline Lutheran; justification and sacramental theology distinct from Tridentine Catholic definitions.

denominations.name: Reformed Church in the United States
denominations.summary: German Reformed confessional body; Protestant against Trent and papal jurisdiction.

denominations.name: Wisconsin Evangelical Lutheran Synod
denominations.summary: Confessional Lutheran; rejects Trent on justification, Mass, and papal primacy.

denominations.name: Brethren in Christ Church
denominations.summary: Anabaptist-Pietist; believers’ baptism against Catholic infant baptism and hierarchy.

denominations.name: Apostolic Christian Church
denominations.summary: Froehlich Anabaptist; believers’ baptism and separation from Catholic sacramental order.

denominations.name: Molokans
denominations.summary: Russian Spiritual Christian dissent; reject Orthodox/Catholic ritual and hierarchy.

denominations.name: Doukhobors
denominations.summary: Russian Spiritual Christian; reject sacraments and clergy as Catholic/Orthodox churches define them.

denominations.name: Priestless Old Believers (Bespopovtsy)

denominations.name: Ukrainian Autocephalous Orthodox Church
denominations.summary: Ukrainian autocephaly against Moscow; still non-Roman, rejects Vatican I papal definitions.

denominations.name: United Methodist Church
denominations.summary: Mainline Methodist union; Protestant against papal primacy and Tridentine sacramental definitions.

denominations.name: Church of God of Prophecy
denominations.summary: Holiness-Pentecostal; rejects Catholic hierarchical and sacramental claims.

denominations.name: Bible Presbyterian Church

denominations.name: Associate Reformed Presbyterian Church
denominations.summary: Scottish-American Reformed; Protestant against Trent and papacy.

denominations.name: Reformed Church in America
denominations.summary: Dutch Reformed in America; Protestant against Trent and papal primacy.

denominations.name: United Reformed Church
denominations.summary: UK Reformed union; Protestant against Catholic magisterium.

denominations.name: Church of Scotland

denominations.name: American Baptist Churches USA
denominations.summary: Baptist; believers’ baptism against Catholic infant baptism and hierarchy.

denominations.name: Cooperative Baptist Fellowship
denominations.summary: Baptist fellowship; Protestant against Catholic sacramental and papal claims.

denominations.name: Mennonite Church USA

denominations.name: Friends United Meeting

denominations.name: Moravian Church (Unitas Fratrum worldwide)

denominations.name: Unity Church

denominations.name: Centers for Spiritual Living
